source_snapshot.procedure: Check spec, set BIOS Memory Operating mode to default, compare BIOS/OS size.
source_snapshot.criteria: Capacity matches; DC and warm reboot plus stress have no errors.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES uses filtered DMI only and claims independent channels.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires authoritative mode, BIOS evidence, complete capacity/topology, separate DC/warm phases and stress.

old_problem: Independent versus default label, criteria-only DC/warm/stress phases and capacity semantics were unbound; DMI locators alone could not prove controller mode.
disposition_reason: The objective and required phases are identifiable. The exact BIOS label, DIMM/channel map, reboot count and stress profile are project runtime bindings; they can be fail-closed without keeping an Engineering Decision Pending. ED-06 requires DC and warm reboot to remain separate, and ED-11 prohibits arbitrary BIOS changes.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row40 all18 XLSX cells and history2654.
Preserved Independent/default mode, BIOS/OS capacity, distinct DC and warm reboot, and stress coverage.
Rejected filtered DMI as mode proof; no BIOS, power, reboot or stress action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized Independent memory-mode capacity, reboot and stress state matrix
test_case.purpose: Verify the approved Independent memory-controller mode exposes the expected full capacity/topology across BIOS, OS, DC boot, warm reboot and bounded stress.
required_package: Approved board/BIOS revision and exact Independent/default label/value
DIMM/rank/channel map and BIOS installed/available versus OS usable capacity tolerance
Qualified operator/KVM plus approved setting-change and known-good restore plan
Separate DC-cycle and warm-reboot counts/order with OS-ready definition
Approved stress tool/version/workload/duration and ECC/OOM/thermal/power/watchdog limits
test_case.test_command: Capture the current BIOS mode and full topology; operator sets only the approved Independent/default value. For baseline, each approved DC boot and each separate warm reboot, capture visual BIOS mode/capacity and secure full DMI/NUMA/OS capacity plus boot/SEL/ECC evidence through OS Ready. Then run only the approved bounded memory stress with continuous health monitoring and restore the recorded setting if required.
test_case.expected_result: Independent mode remains explicitly selected, expected full capacity/channel topology is present in BIOS and OS after every distinct transition, stress completes within limits, and no new training/ECC/SEL/platform error occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires direct BIOS mode evidence, capacity/topology reconciliation, independent DC and warm-reboot results, and approved stress evidence. DMI locators alone cannot prove the operating mode.
safety_gate: Only the approved BIOS field may change; no all/random modification.
Qualified operator owns BIOS, DC and warm actions; capture known-good restore first.
Do not merge DC with warm reboot or skip full OFF-to-OS-ready evidence where DC is required.
Abort on no-POST, topology/capacity mismatch, ECC/SEL/OOM/thermal/power/watchdog fault; no auto-retry.
expected_evidence: Board/BIOS/DIMM/channel baseline and before/after BIOS screenshots
Per-phase BIOS/OS capacity plus full DMI/NUMA topology
Separate DC and warm reboot timestamps, state transitions and OS-ready health
test_case.recovery: On no-POST, capacity loss or memory-training error, stop the remaining transition/stress matrix, preserve KVM/POST/SEL/ECC and last-known topology evidence, have the operator restore only the recorded known-good memory mode, and require platform-owner review before any further cycle.

source_conflict.reason: Items and criteria establish Independent mode plus DC/warm/stress coverage; missing phase parameters become mandatory runtime bindings rather than omitted coverage.

blocked.reason: Review is complete; execution waits for BIOS/platform/state-matrix configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind BIOS label/value, topology/capacity tolerance, separate transition matrix, stress profile and recovery.
pending.unlock_condition: No Engineering Decision remains; absent approved state matrix prevents execution/PASS.

project_authority: BIOS label, expected topology/capacity and transition/stress parameters are project inputs.
